Our Mission
At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.
Who We Are
In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
Job Summary
The Team
Information Technology - To stay ahead of the curve, it’s critical to know where the curve is and how to anticipate the changes we’re facing. For the fastest-growing cybersecurity company, the curve is the evolution of cyberattacks and the products and services that proactively address them. Our Product Management team helps us do just that. This team provides the behind-the-scenes support for our products by being a source of information for our Systems Engineers, staying on top of the environment we sell in and helping to implement technical solutions based on our clients' feedback and needs. As threats and technology evolve, we stay ahead to accomplish our mission.
Job Summary
We are seeking a visionary and hands-on Principal Product Manager to lead our Vertical AI strategy, re-imagining core business workflows in Marketing, Sales, Legal, and Finance from the ground up. In this role, you will move beyond generic AI additions to build high-value, domain-specific solutions that directly impact the company's bottom line. You will combine classical product management rigor with AI-native speed, rapidly building functional prototypes to prove concepts and using rigorous frameworks to focus on high-impact use cases that pass feasibility checks for stakes, accuracy, and economics.
Key Responsibilities
+ Own, build, and maintain a prioritized 12-month product roadmap that balances quick wins with long-term strategic bets, translating stakeholder requests into concrete, actionable epics.
+ Serve as the primary liaison between technical engineering and non-technical business leaders, translating complex AI concepts into business risk and effectively managing stakeholder expectations.
+ Develop and execute go-to-market strategies and change management plans, creating launch materials and training guides to ensure successful user adoption of new AI tools.
+ Rapidly build and iterate on functional prototypes using AI-native tools (e.g., Replit, Cursor, no-code builders) to validate process fit and user experience before committing full engineering resources.
+ Utilize prompt engineering in playground environments to test the feasibility of AI solutions, ensuring only viable concepts are added to the engineering roadmap.
+ Define and own the Product Requirements Document (PRD), establishing rigorous, non-negotiable standards for production such as 'Error Budgets' and 'Golden Sets'.
+ Create, curate, and version-control the 'Golden Set'—a definitive dataset of inputs and ideal outputs—to scientifically grade and validate AI model performance.
Qualifications
Required Qualifications
+ Bachelor’s degree with 12+ years of relevant experience, or Master’s degree with 8+ years of relevant experience, or PhD with 5+ years of relevant experience in Product Management.
+ Mandatory hands-on experience building functional prototypes, code snippets, or mock UIs using generative AI tools and no-code/low-code platforms.
+ Expertise in the full software development lifecycle (SDLC), including Agile/Scrum methodologies, backlog grooming, sprint planning, and writing high-quality user stories.
+ Deep understanding of large language model (LLM) capabilities and constraints, including context windows, latency, hallucination rates, and when to apply RAG vs. fine-tuning.
+ Proven experience conducting 'Voice of Customer' interviews and customer discovery in complex B2B environments such as Legal, Finance, or Sales.
Preferred Qualifications
+ A 'Maker' attitude with a portfolio of projects or artifacts built to demonstrate ideas.
+ Track record of shipping complex enterprise software products from concept to launch (0-to-1).
+ Experience defining a North Star metric and instrumenting products to track key business outcomes like adoption, retention, and ROI.
+ Experience managing and curating 'Golden Datasets' for AI/ML model evaluation and acceptance testing.
Compensation Disclosure
The compensation offered for this position will depend on qualifications, experience, and work location. For candidates who receive an offer at the posted level, the starting base salary (for non-sales roles) or base salary + commission target (for sales/com-missioned roles) is expected to be the annual range listed below. The offered compensation may also include restricted stock units and a bonus. A description of our employee benefits may be found here (https://benefits.paloaltonetworks.com/) .
$176,200.00 - $284,900.00/yr
Our Commitment
We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com .
Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

**Compensation:** $147,000 – $185,000 base salary, plus equity, company benefits, and incentive compensation.  
**Location:** Washington, DC or San Francisco, CA. These are the only two locations under consideration. No other locations, and no fully remote option.

### **About the Client**

Our client is a venture-backed AI security company. Their platform helps government and enterprise customers put AI systems into production safely: evaluating models and applications before deployment, protecting sensitive data and enforcing policy at runtime, governing what AI agents are allowed to do, and maintaining the evidence trail oversight bodies require. The platform runs across cloud, hybrid, on-prem, edge, and air-gapped environments. The team is standing up a dedicated public sector organization, and these are early seats on it.

### **About the Role**

Our client is looking for a Public Sector AI Product Manager to help shape their platform for high-consequence government and national security environments.

This role sits at the intersection of AI product strategy, customer discovery, technical execution, public sector mission needs, and go-to-market enablement. You will work directly with government stakeholders, mission users, technical evaluators, security teams, and the company's engineering, research, delivery, and growth teams to turn customer signal into product direction.

This is a hands-on, customer-facing product role. You will define product requirements, guide roadmap priorities, support pilots and deployments, analyze model and system behavior, and make sure investment translates into measurable customer and mission outcomes.

* Become deeply fluent in the company's evaluation, guardrail, and agent governance platform.
* Build deep relationships with public sector customers, mission users, technical evaluators, and executive stakeholders to understand operational needs, constraints, and success criteria.

* Partner with engineering, research, design, delivery, and go-to-market teams to prioritize and ship capabilities that solve real customer problems.
* Analyze AI system behavior, evaluation results, datasets, failure modes, guardrail decisions, and customer workflows to refine product direction.
* Create customer-facing narratives, demos, product collateral, battle cards, and executive-ready materials that support adoption and market readiness.
* Track whether product investments are delivering measurable outcomes, including risk reduction, deployment acceleration, operational control, and mission value.

### **You Might Thrive in This Role If You**

* Enjoy operating at the intersection of AI, product strategy, mission needs, technical execution, and customer outcomes.
* Have strong ownership instincts and are comfortable driving product direction through ambiguity.
* Communicate clearly with engineers, researchers, executives, technical evaluators, mission users, and go-to-market teams.
* Like spending time with customers directly, including on-site, to build a high-fidelity understanding of their workflows and constraints.
* Are comfortable turning messy feedback, prototype learnings, and field observations into clear product decisions.
* Think in terms of measurable outcomes, not just shipped features.
* Are excited to shape AI evaluation, runtime control, and agent governance products for high-stakes public sector environments.

### **Requirements**

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* 5+ years in product management, AI product strategy, technical program management, solutions, product engineering, strategy consulting, enterprise SaaS, or other customer-facing technical roles.

Aegis AI is building the next generation of email security — powered by AI agents that think and act like human analysts. Our mission is to keep users safe. Our agents stop Phishing and Spam attacks before they reach employees, using hundreds of specialized models that collaborate autonomously across inboxes.

Our team was founded by the Google security leaders who built Gmail and Chrome Security. Backed by Accel and Foundation Capital, we’re transforming how enterprises protect their people from modern social engineering threats.

**The Role**

We’re looking for an **AI Product Manager** to lead the roadmap for Aegis AI’s threat detection engine — the core layer that identifies, classifies, and explains modern email attacks.

This roleis at the heart of our mission: improving detection performance while maintaining precision and trust. You’ll collaborate closely with data scientists, AI engineers, and security researchers to design how our multi-agent AI system learns from adversarial behavior, detects zero-day threats, and continuously improves through real-world feedback.

Your work will directly impact the system’s ability to uncover sophisticated attacks, account compromise, and deep social engineering attempts that legacy tools miss.

**Responsibilities**

**1\. Understand the Threat Environment**

* Investigate real-world attacks and their associated data, threat reports to uncover detection gaps and trends.
    
* Partner with the Engineering team, security analysts and customers to understand attacker tactics, behaviors, and potential false-negative patterns.
    
* Synthesize insights from data and detections into actionable intelligence to inform the product direction.  
    

**2\. Design and Prioritize the Detection Roadmap**

* Define the roadmap for Aegis’ detection systems — focusing on AI agents, underlying model improvements, and signal coverage.
    
* Work closely with AI Engineering and Security/Threat Intel analysts to translate threat insights into detection requirements.
    
* Set success metrics around precision and recall; track performance and iterate.  
    

**3\. Communicate Detection to Customers**

* Collaborate with GTM teams to clearly explain how detections work and what type of threats they catch.
    
* Publish thought leadership pieces from Aegis’ threat intelligence
    
* Build internal tools and narratives that help customers trust, validate, and adopt our products to protect their organizations.
    
* Translate technical results into compelling value stories around protection, ROI, and visibility.  
    

**4\. Work with Engineering to Implement and Deploy Improvements**

* Partner with AI and Infra teams to operationalize detection models safely, efficiently, and at scale.
    
* Define requirements for detection improvements, feedback loops, and evaluation pipelines.
    
* Ensure rapid iteration between research, development, and production rollout.
    

**Who You Are**

* 5+ years of Product Management experience.
    
* Strong understanding of ML and AI fundamentals: model training, evaluation, and deployment.
    
* Proven ability to balance model performance with precision and explainability requirements.
    
* Skilled at translating complex technical problems into clear, measurable product goals.
    
* Experienced working cross-functionally with research, data, and engineering teams.
    
* Exceptional communication skills — you can discuss embeddings and evaluation metrics as comfortably as customer pain points.
    
* Strong ability to balance working with Customers directly + Engineering + GTM teams.
    
* If you’re an ex founder or are looking to learn about becoming one. Our Product Managers are expected to behave like GMs and true owners of their space perfectly preparing you to run your own business/P&L. You will be learning from Product Leads with >20 years of combined experience in Product Management from Google.
    
* (Bonus) Experience in cybersecurity, email security, or fraud detection systems.
    
* (Bonus) Familiarity with transformer models, fine-tuning, or agentic architectures.
